source_role: Eight previously observed development games: two baseline, four candidate and two teacher_task games, with a fixed crop model and common controller opportunity generation. Actual selected tasks are the targets; this is not pure teacher imitation.
motivation: Test whether first selected tasks with observed immediate official effects carry a small generalizable offline imitation signal, while preserving unknown episodes and acknowledging selection bias.
training: One fixed random initialization and 128 GPU updates; only completed_observed episode origins enter gradients; final checkpoint is sealed before any new test game. Train-only normalization and smoothed opportunity-aware frequency baseline; no checkpoint selection or test tuning.
input_boundary: Network receives only decision-time shared and candidate vectors from the frozen opportunity controller. Seed, source, chosen target and completion status do not enter features. Source identity relies on published per-game hashes and prior frozen actor reconstruction.
evaluation: Two previously unconsumed seeds, two fixed opponents, both seats, eight complete teacher_task-plus-frozen-crop-model games; evaluate every episode origin and report completed and unknown separately, with seed and operation breakdowns. These are data collection games, not games controlled by the new model.
transition_budget_breakdown: 8 live games + 8 original-worker primary replays + 8 separate label replays + 1 fixed independent replay, each 719 transitions
deviation_from_independent_advice: The separately budgeted eight label replays add 5752 transitions to the suggested 12223; this reuses the accepted official worker unchanged and avoids modifying its replay audit. No additional games are created.
independent_check: One fixed game and 20 SHA256-identity-selected episode origins; identities are selected without viewing status. Review separately implemented label judgments and disclose common engine/instrumentation.
admission: Fixed offline top-1, CE, per-seed and multi-class metrics are exploratory; passing them is neither statistical significance nor competitive improvement and never promotes a model. Complete model-controlled matches require a separate prospective stage.
stop: No retries, new seeds, extra games, altered thresholds or post-test tuning after an input, fit or collection attempt is consumed. Failures and partial outputs remain local and are reported honestly.
privacy: No raw replay, trace, per-step state, individual label, feature matrix, logits, checkpoint, user or machine details are published.
